name: Gene Munster
zh_summary: Gene Munster is getting more concerned about $AMZN as personalized bots make it easier to find what you want, attacking Amazon's key advantage of discovery while speed and trust remain. Early data and Zuck's comment on Muse's commerce use case support this; global daily bot usage ~20m, expected 2B in three years. Also concerned about $GOOG needing an answer to personalized bots, with cloud growth expectations of 92% Sept / 95% Dec and capex street at $201B CY26 / $312B CY27.
en_summary: Gene Munster is getting more concerned about $AMZN as personalized bots make it easier to find what you want, attacking Amazon's key advantage of discovery while speed and trust remain. Early data and Zuck's comment on Muse's commerce use case support this; global daily bot usage ~20m, expected 2B in three years. Also concerned about $GOOG needing an answer to personalized bots, with cloud growth expectations of 92% Sept / 95% Dec and capex street at $201B CY26 / $312B CY27.
text:
I'm also getting more concerned about $AMZN because personalized bots will make it easy to find just what you're looking for, making them a logical starting point for anything we buy.

Amazon wins for three reasons: 1. Find what you want, 2. Speed, 3. Trust. Number 1 will increasingly be under attack.

Early data says this is happening, with Zuck's comment last week that Muse's main use case is commerce. 

Global daily bot usage is around 20m. I bet it's 2B in three years.
